        const transEnabled = false;

            if(evt.eventType === 'started-data-refresh'){
                let stepData = taskManager.getStepData('offline','db');
                if(stepData && !stepData.args){
                    taskManager.updateStep('offline', 'db', {args:[{lookup: lookupEnabled, delta: lookupDelta, trans: transEnabled, map: false, attachment: false }]});

        });
    }
